en: Black‑and‑white landscape view of a small European town or village at the edge of a forested hillside. The foreground shows rows of mature trees and densely packed houses with steep, gabled roofs and stucco facades. Behind them, slightly larger late‑19th‑/early‑20th‑century villas and apartment blocks rise up the slope in orderly rows. At the center is a distinctive building with a tall, narrow spire or turret. Fields and a thick coniferous forest cover the upper slopes and background hills. No visible text appears on the front side.
